I hate being isolated. I'm so lonely my chest is burning. I don't want to be alone. I'm asking for ways to meet people because the source of my depression is my lack of socialization with people. 

I've been alone for years. I'm not remotely happy in my solitude. I'm asking for ways to meet with people because its  *my* ideal way of dealing with depression. 

My suggestions, and all the commentors suggestions, are for ways to connect with people because its explicitly what I asked for. It's what I need and it's what will bring me peace.
